# Move File

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Moves the given file to a given folder

## Syntax

~~~~text
moveFile(file: <#Variable#>, folder: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
moveFile(file: ShortcutInput, folder: Clipboard)
~~~~
